timeline.speaker: NARRATOR
timeline.text: The morning light fell across the study.

timeline.speaker: Elizabeth
timeline.text: It was a truth universally acknowledged that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife, and the neighbourhood took the matter as settled long before he had any say in it at all, which is how these things usually go.
